description: This file defines JavaScript classes and functions related to date/time handling and UI components for SuiteCRM, including SugarClass, SugarContainer, and SugarDateTime, with inheritance and date parsing/formatting methods.

classes.name: SugarClass
classes.description: Base class with init method and inheritance support.

classes.name: SugarContainer
classes.description: UI container class inheriting from SugarClass, manages DOM element and widget loading.

classes.name: SugarDateTime
classes.description: Handles date/time parsing, formatting, and conversions, inheriting from SugarClass.

methods.name: SugarContainer.prototype.init
methods.description: Initializes SugarContainer with root DOM element.

methods.name: SugarContainer.prototype.start
methods.description: Creates and loads the root widget.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.mysql2jsDateTime
methods.description: Converts MySQL date and time strings to JavaScript Date object.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.prototype.getFormattedDate
methods.description: Returns formatted date string based on user preferences.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.getAMPM
methods.description: Returns 'AM' or 'PM' based on the hour.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.prototype.parseUTCDate
methods.description: Parses UTC date string into Date object.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.prototype.parseAdjustedDate
methods.description: Parses date string with DST and GMT offset adjustments.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.prototype.getUTCHash
methods.description: Generates a UTC hash string from a Date object.
